title: Yaiba: Ninja Gaiden Z
summary: The once-proud Ninja Gaiden falters again with unbalanced zombie hack-n-slash spin-off Yaiba: Ninja Gaiden Z.

title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
summary: More than just a shinier version of the same game you remember, Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced brings what was already one of the best games in the series up to today’s standards.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved speaks to the series' timelessness and adds a decent set of new missions, but it's a mostly a lean retread that's more of a test run for its future with Unreal Engine.

title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
summary: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu is an entertaining co-op horror excursion that can sometimes feel a bit too oppressive.
